Container.Name: plant-ledger
Container.Overview: Self-hosted houseplant tracker: searchable inventory, per-plant photos, care-group tagging, and a soil/fertilizer/repot log. Single container, SQLite-backed, no external dependencies. Fronted by greatestnotion.com via Nginx Proxy Manager.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port mapped to the app's internal port 3000

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite DB + photos - this folder is the entire application state

Config.Name: AUTH_PASSWORD
Config.Description: App-level HTTP Basic Auth backstop password. Leave blank to disable (rely on the NPM Access List only).
